body:
Source: repo-bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2, issue #1043). plugins/adlc-pi/test/handoff-deny.test.mjs manually invokes mkdtempSync across 13 calls and guards removals in 61 try/finally blocks, and is allowlisted in scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs. With @adlc/core/test-kit (tmp), fixture directories automatically register cleanup via t.after when passed the test context t.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In plugins/adlc-pi/test/handoff-deny.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update test declarations using temporary directories to accept the t parameter from test(...).
   - Replace mkdtempSync calls with tmp(t, prefix) (e.g. 'pi-handoff-deny-').
   - Remove manual try { ... } finally { rmSync(dir, ...); } blocks, unindenting test bodies.
2. In scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs:
   - Remove plugins/adlc-pi/test/handoff-deny.test.mjs from the ALLOWLIST set.
3. Verification:
   - node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/handoff-deny.test.mjs exits 0 with all 91 tests passing.
   - node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.
   - grep -c 'finally' plugins/adlc-pi/test/handoff-deny.test.mjs returns 0.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 plugins/adlc-pi/test/handoff-deny.test.mjs contains 0 finally blocks.
- AC2 mkdtempSync is not called in plugins/adlc-pi/test/handoff-deny.test.mjs.
- AC3 grep -E 'plugins/adlc-pi/test/handoff-deny\.test\.mjs' scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs returns nothing.
- AC4 node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/handoff-deny.test.mjs exits 0.
- AC5 node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.
- AC6 adlc rails-guard exits 0.
title: refactor(adlc-pi): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit and eliminate 61 try/finally blocks in handoff-deny tests
